overall_reason: A lavender scene ground #e8e5ef, lavender tiles, violet status text #694ba8 and a plum button #62547e have no traceable source, and the same 'done' state is violet in two windows and green in the third.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE finds no source for the violet family, T-PALETTE-ROLES finds one state in two colours, and T-NEUTRALS finds cool greys on a warm window body; the plum is at least held to the one action.

findings.title: State colours keep their meaning
findings.where: '24 assets ready' and 'All comments resolved' (violet) against 'Assets approved' and 'Feedback resolved' (green), 1440 and 375, tiles/1440-00.png
findings.evidence: The palette table lists #694ba8 (hue 296) on 2 text elements and #527764 (green) on 2 text elements. All four are check-marked completion labels.
findings.before: Completed states are violet in the Assets and Feedback windows and green in the Publish window.
findings.after: One success colour for every completed check, with the accent kept for the action.
findings.why: The reader has to learn two colours for 'done', and violet also marks the action, so state and action blur.

findings.title: Do not use violet/lavender in the page's own palette
findings.where: scene ground and placeholder tiles, 1440 and 375, bg-1440.png
findings.evidence: The area palette at 1440 lists #e8e5ef at 4.8%, lavender tiles #ddd3f4 and #62547e on the 'Publish release' button. The window shadow is tinted purple: rgba(143,126,182,0.2) 0 0 0 1px with rgba(76,54,99,0.3) 0 12px. Nothing in the composition names a brand that owns violet.
findings.before: Lavender ground, lavender tiles, violet text, a plum button and purple-tinted shadows.
findings.after: An accent sampled from the client's own imagery or brand (Sample, Converge, Justify), held to the primary action.
findings.why: With no source, the violet family reads as a model default rather than this product's colour.

findings.title: Neutrals hold one temperature
findings.evidence: The window body is warm #f6f5f4, while the heading ink #35414a and the meta grey #84909a are cool (4 cool counts in the neutral temperature table).
findings.before: Cool blue-grey text on a warm off-white body inside a lavender scene.
findings.after: One neutral temperature: text greys tinted toward the body's hue, or a body tinted toward the greys.
findings.why: Three temperatures in one window make the neutrals look assembled rather than derived.

strengths: The plum #62547e is used once, on the one primary action 'Publish release'.
The windows share one shadow recipe, and no card doubles a border with a shadow.
not_investigated: T-DARK-MODE: the page renders light; the stylesheet has a dark class theme that the capture did not render, so dark mode is not verified
brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours were available for T-COLOUR-SOURCE; sources were traced from the composition itself
contrast and focus: owned by the sweep (A11-001, A11-003) and not restated here
The caption above the scene (#666666) is the capture's framing and was left out of the text levels
